reviews.text: I loved the service, the welcome was fantastic, she was very patient and warm with the dogs. I have four Golden Retrievers and I'm delighted to be able to bring my dogs in for a gentle grooming experience and entrust them to her with complete confidence. I highly recommend her!
Yellow dog, the groomer, was very welcoming and caring with my little dog, attentive and offered good advice.

The salon is filthy. The groomer is terrible, don't go there under any circumstances, her salon is disgusting. You don't have your diploma, it took 3 hours to massacre him, it's impossible, such a massacre! She was supposed to trim my dog's hair to 16 millimeters and she went from 19 millimeters to 9. She deliberately sabotaged him and was acting in bad faith. She told me, "That's how my clippers are, I go from 19 to 9," and said, "I'm not taking him anymore, I'm not taking you anymore, you've made a mess of it." I asked her to groom my Shih Tzu, I told her, "You're not going to trim millimeters," she said, "No." I explained it to her however I wanted, she groomed him twice, it was fine, the third time was a disaster. One ear is bigger than the other, he's all red from head to toe. He didn't have any knots on his back, only on his belly. I called her over and asked her, "How many millimeters did you trim?" Without telling me, she said, "I did 9 millimeters." He's red all over, it's a massacre, his feet are red, she couldn't even straighten his ears.

First grooming session for my English Cocker Spaniel and the result is very satisfying!

You can go there with complete confidence! The groomer is very meticulous and does her job with passion. 😊 A big thank you to Yellow Dog, we'll be back!!

A very friendly groomer who listened to the needs of my Pomeranian, very smiley and open to discussion, I recommend her without hesitation, thank you again.

I recommend her 200%! I've been leaving my English Cocker Spaniel with her for almost six months now, and she takes her time, is so kind, and does a very professional job. Thank you again for everything!

A loyal customer for years, I always entrust my Persian cat to this groomer with complete confidence. He is perfectly groomed, washed with a natural, unscented shampoo, his claws are carefully trimmed, and he always leaves clean, fragrant, and relaxed.

What I particularly appreciate is the gentleness and patience with which she cares for him: no stress, no fear from my cat, who is quite sensitive. Rare professionalism and a true love for animals. Thank you again!

(ps: photo of my cat getting out of the bath and being dried)

I came in for my cat who had enormous knots, to the point where we couldn't even get our hands through his fur. It was his first grooming session, and the woman was incredibly gentle and patient. She had to use clippers, explaining that it's a last resort when you can't untangle the fur. This woman is passionate about her work; she took the time to explain everything to me, and I left very satisfied with the service. I highly recommend this salon.

I'm very satisfied with this salon. I originally came to have my cat's mats removed, but they were so thick that the groomer had to use clippers. She was incredibly gentle and patient. It was my 14-year-old cat's first grooming session, and she was amazing. I thank her a thousand times over. I highly recommend this salon.
